title: As Tesla’s AI Becomes “Tesla Super Intelligence,” Sheeraz Hasan Holds Hollywood.AI, Hollywood.SI, Bollywood.AI and Bollywood.SI
description: New Delhi [India], October 9: Tesla's official artificial intelligence account on X now goes by 'Tesla Super Intelligence,' under the handle @TeslaSI. The account has more than 510,000 followers, and its former handle, @Tesla_AI, no longer exists. It is the latest move in a pattern now too large to dismiss as a political slogan. The technology industry is changing its vocabulary from Artificial Intelligence to Super Intelligence, and Sheeraz Hasan's FAME owns and controls the names that carry that change into entertainment: Hollywood.AI, Hollywood.SI, Bollywood.AI and Bollywood.SI.
